symptom: mendixlabs/mxcli#1618: `datagrid dg (…, itemSelection: Single)` / `gallery g (…, itemSelection: None)` passed check, exec and mx check and stored PrimitiveValue "Single"/"None" with Selection left at the default (None on a grid, Single on a gallery) — no selection, and no way to turn a gallery's off. `itemSelection: Bogus` was accepted, and `gallery (…, advanced: true)` was discarded (Gallery 3.4.0 declares no `advanced`; the hand-written definition maps it to the constant false)
cause: resolveMapping's Selection source read only the `Selection:` keyword; the explicit-key pass skipped 'already handled' names by the mappings' SOURCE keywords, not their property keys, so the key fell to the scalar branch (SetPrimitive). refuseUndeclaredMappedKey exempted every constant mapping, including one the script overrode by key
file: mdl/executor/widget_selection_value.go (selectionMappingValue), widget_engine.go (explicit pass, refuseUndeclaredMappedKey), validate_widget_selection.go (MDL-WIDGET50), validate_widgets.go + widget_known_props_from_mpk.go (declaredKeys)
insight: Already named as trap (3) in the 2026-10-17 describe-by-key finding — grep the findings for the KEY name before diagnosing, the cause may be written down beside a different fix. A widget property has two spellings (the mapping's Source keyword and its PropertyKey) and every reader must treat them as one: the builder, the explicit pass, and the rules that judge the value (the Gallery click-ambiguity rule read only `Selection`, so `itemSelection: None` + onClick was falsely MDL-WIDGET36; on the pre-fix build mxbuild really did fail it, 'The item click action is ambiguous', and passes it after). mxbuild 11.12.5 accepts Selection "Bogus" at 0 errors even with --no-update-widgets, so the refusal is load-bearing. The best runtime-free proof was structural: the by-key grid's widget object is identical to the keyword-spelled grid's (ids stripped), and differs on the pre-fix build. The declared-key check needs the INSTALLED package (check -p): the embedded template is a guess about the version, so without a project it stays quiet and exec refuses
